content.title: THE ORGAN-FOOD PAIRINGS YOUR BODY IS WAITING FOR
facts: **Kidneys** - Cranberries, Beets, Parsley: cranberries help stop bacteria from clinging to the urinary tract, beets improve blood flow to filter waste faster.
**Liver** - Beetroot, Turmeric, Walnuts: turmeric supports enzymes that break down toxins, walnuts supply amino acids the liver uses for detox.
**Bladder** - Watermelon, Celery, Cucumber: these high-water foods flush the urinary tract and dilute irritants that cause discomfort.
**Thyroid** - Brazil nuts, Seaweed, Eggs: 2 Brazil nuts/day cover your selenium needs, seaweed provides iodine the thyroid needs to make hormones.
**Joints** - Bone broth, Cherries, Turmeric: cherries carry compounds that calm inflammation around stiff joints.
**Bones** - Sardines' cousin, canned salmon, Kale, Sesame seeds: 1 tbsp sesame seeds/day delivers a solid calcium boost for bone density.
**Ears** - Bananas, Dark chocolate, Sunflower seeds: potassium in bananas helps regulate fluid balance in the inner ear.
**Follow along** - for more daily health tips like this.

caption:
Your kidneys work around the clock, and cranberries can actually make their job easier - compounds in cranberries make it harder for bacteria to stick to the urinary tract walls, which is why they're often recommended for anyone prone to discomfort down there. Turmeric does something similar for your liver: it supports the enzyme pathways your liver relies on to break down and clear out toxins, so a little goes a long way when added to food regularly. And Brazil nuts are almost too easy to overlook - just 2 a day can cover your daily selenium needs, a mineral your thyroid depends on to produce hormones properly. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and adjust from there.
